  Claude in Chrome

  Claude in Chrome works with the Chrome extension to let you control your browser directly from Claude Code. You can navigate websites, fill forms, capture
  screenshots, record GIFs, and debug with console logs and network requests.

  Requires the Chrome extension. Get started at https://claude.ai/chrome

  Site-level permissions are inherited from the Chrome extension. Manage permissions in the Chrome extension settings to control which sites Claude can
  browse, click, and type on.

  For more info, use /chrome or visit https://code.claude.com/docs/en/chrome

  Enter to confirm · Esc to cancel
